A person at Theorem must decide this change, because it takes `tests/` out of code-owner review.

After the merge, a change under `tests/` can merge without approval from @⁠theorem-labs/engineering (`.github/CODEOWNERS:21-22` at the head). This covers what pytest loads in `tests.yaml` as well as the test files: `tests.yaml:197` runs `pytest tests`. pytest loads `tests/conftest.py`. It also looks for its configuration in `tests/` before the top of the checkout. So pytest would read a `tests/pytest.ini` instead of the `/pytest.ini` that `CODEOWNERS:30` owns.

Decide whether the required check `tests` can change on one maintainer's review.
- If it can, merge the change as it is.
- If it cannot, keep `/tests/` owned, or add owners for `/tests/conftest.py` and the pytest configuration files in `/tests/`.
